procedure: State: Three deployed changes and workload variation are candidate contributors to a new regression. Procedure: List the competing explanations; compare symptoms in traces, counters and matched replay tests; weaken explanations contradicted by observations. Limits and stopping conditions: Confounding, incomplete explanations and unrepresentative replay limit attribution.
action: List the competing explanations; compare symptoms in traces, counters and matched replay tests; weaken explanations contradicted by observations.
observables: Each candidate agrees or conflicts with observed latency, workload and replay behavior.
inferential_warrant: Retain supported candidate contributions and explicitly unresolved alternatives; temporal association alone does not identify a cause.
problem_decomposition: Ordinary candidate causes: deployed changes, load and configuration.
next_inquiry: Use ordinary discriminating replay or rollback/reintroduction, then check whether the regression returns under comparable conditions.
